title: Sonic the Hedgehog (Sega Master System) - Green Hill Zone
description:
This is a version of the Green Hill Zone foreground tile set from the Sega Master System version of "Sonic the Hedgehog".

To note, this set contains several variations on the slope tiles so objects may overlap without too much trouble.
